title: ICGV 95390 peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: ICGV 95390 peanut: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: ICGV 95390 peanut is a peanut variety. 104 to 106 days to harvest, 1.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: ICGV 95390 is a registered peanut variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2013 as NSIC 2013 Pn 17. It takes 104 to 106 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.81 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

ICGV 95390 peanut takes 104 to 106 days from sowing to harvest. That is 3.7 days longer than the average of the 26 peanut varieties with a day count, 101.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.81 t/ha matches the average of its group, 1.85. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up
Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit peanut fields most often: [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [thrips](/pests/thrips). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
A hundred seeds weigh about 78.9 grams, so the higher this number, the bigger the seed.
Where and when to plant ICGV 95390 peanut

It is recommended for both the wet and the dry season. Mani needs loose, well drained soil to fill its pods. Pick a variety by seed size for your buyer, and one rated against rust and leaf spot for the wet season.
